jobs.title: Patient Monitoring Coordinator (RN)
jobs.description_text: Patient Monitoring Coordinator (RN) Location: Hollywood , FL Schedule: Full-Time Salary: $28.85 an hour - $36.06 an hour (based on CPT codes) About Infinite Medical P.C. Job Summary We are seeking a dedicated RN CoCM Care Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing patient charts and communicating with the Clinical department and providers about any irregularities as part of chronic care management. Responsibilities Provide assessment and care management services, including: Administration of validated rating scales. Initiation of behavioral health care planning concerning behavioral or psychiatric health problems. Revision and modification of care plans for patients not progressing or whose status changes. Brief psychosocial interventions as needed. Engage in ongoing collaboration with the billing practitioner. Maintain the registry/tracking sheets. Consult with the psychiatric consultant. Maintain a continuous relationship with patients. Foster collaborative, integrated relationships with the rest of the care team. Conduct interdisciplinary care plan meetings to review patient beneficiaries. Requirements RN License required Experience in long-term care is preferred. Experience in behavioral health preferred. Benefits Competitive salary: $28.85 an hour - $36.06 an hour (based on CPT codes) Health Dental Vision 401K Company-Sponsored Life Insurance Paid Time Off Why Work With Us?

jobs.description_text: Podiatrist Location: Queens, NY Schedule: Part-Time (2 days/ week) Total Annual Compensation: $60,000 - $90,000 per year About Infinite Medical P.C. Job Summary We are seeking a friendly and compassionate Podiatrist to join our team. As a Podiatrist, you will play a crucial role in providing comprehensive care to patients in long-term care facilities. This is an exciting opportunity to make a difference in the lives of patients while working alongside a dedicated team of healthcare professionals. Responsibilities Performed examinations on patients’ legs and feet to identify and diagnose various diseases and conditions. Provide treatment for foot and leg injuries, such as fractures, corns, and calluses. Recommend and prescribe medication for relieving joint pain and suggest foot orthoses to enhance mobility and alleviate discomfort. Offer guidance and advice to patients regarding foot care and overall wellness practices. Request additional medical tests as necessary based on the initial assessments. Requirements Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (DPM) degree DEA License Long-term care experience Prolonged standing/walking. Occasional lifting up to 20 lbs. Bending/stooping. Benefits Competitive salary: $60,000 - $90,000 per year Paid subscription to UpToDate Malpractice Insurance Why Work With Us? Maintains specimen integrity by using aseptic technique, following department procedures; observing isolation procedures. Tracks collected specimens by initialing, dating, and noting times of collection; maintaining daily tallies of collections performed. Maintains quality results by following department procedures and testing schedule; recording results in the quality-control log; identifying and reporting needed changes. Maintains safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following standards and procedures; complying with legal regulations. Resolves unusual test orders by contacting the physician, pathologist, nursing station, or reference laboratory; referring unresolved orders back to the originator for further clarification; notifying supervisor of unresolved orders. Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations. Enhances phleboto
